payload.text: At the ISSUE:0003 rollout, hv's live check (waits for hv to turn shared mode on, and for a slot from the estate's desk, since step 3 restarts every Claude session on the Mac): a session launched with ccusage dir's export reports the active profile's email from claude auth status, with the Claude Code-credentials item count from dump-keychain (metadata only) the same before and after; ccusage use NAME leaves launchd's CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR naming NAME's profile dir; Claude Usage lists exactly five accounts and nothing prompts.
